observations.observation: Read all3359 characters. The opening narrows an established radio-propagation field to ocean reflection while retaining overall-path and application coverage. Three explicit parts then preserve the deliverable structure. Part1 starts from a literature calm-surface baseline, adds simulated waves, and names finite-element correction and a CCIR-standard alternative before adding atmospheric losses and a source-power/noise threshold. Its hop count is conditional on these settings, not comparable to another paper without matching them. Part2 changes material and geometric parameters to transfer the model to land and reports terrain-dependent powers/hops. Part3 introduces polarization/mismatch for moving receivers and converts hop coverage intervals into reception time only if direction and speed are known; no actual duration is given. This distinguishes an available downstream calculation from a completed numerical result. Preserve awkward/source-specific claims and all numerical text without checking formulas. 'studyof'/'inthe' need checked word spacing, and competition-form fields remain in the candidate. Existing legacy q41 artifacts/deletion states were not changed; this is a separate database-reading receipt, not repeated paper closure or source acceptance.
